ctx.x: So you, uh, so your brother taught you to play the bass?
My brother, Simon. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Um. Farming something else. My daddy was dead when he was older. Uh-huh. So he stopped me. Me and Albert Morgan, you ever? Tell you about Albert Morgan?

items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: Me and him come together. We learn together. Simon learned both of us.

ctx.x: And the other one was Albert Morgan. Oh yes, he's a young fellow though.
Me and him come together. We learn together. Simon learned both of us.
Is that right? I talked to him for a while out in California about three years ago. He could play. Yeah, I heard him play at times. He could play. He still plays out there. He's still playing.
